flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: No court application batch display code. Only UI data types (Icourtcase.d.ts: court_no, court_time, mention_date, csd_batch_no), Court Room No/Batch Limit/Duration parameters in System.ts, and court report stubs in Report/index.tsx with no path; no page, endpoint, summary or pre-populated fields.
note: The story asks for a screen showing the batch number, a notice summary (by ID type, notice type, ID number) and pre-populated editable fields (court number, court division, court mention date/time). There is no page or endpoint for it. The repo only has type definitions in the UI (Icourtcase.d.ts:22-28; court_division at :7), System admin parameter menu entries (System.ts:119-154), and 'Court Application Submit/Vault Reports' entries whose path is empty with the resource commented out (Report/index.tsx:61-68, ActionReport.tsx:43-48), so they cannot be opened as reports. No relevant maintenance ticket. Cannot verify from repo: the feature in another system.
recommendation: Do not claim as completed based on this repo. The reports and data types are placeholders; confirm with URA/the team where the batch review screen code lives, or mark it as a gap.

steps.step: OCMS displays the selected batch number
steps.detail: No code: grep for court application / court batch / courtBatch / csd_batch / CourtApplication / process-cpc in ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmsadminui, ocmseserviceapi and thirdpartyapi finds no controller, service or UI page to select or review a court application batch. Only the csd_batch_no type and a search function that is never called; no screen renders a batch number.

steps.step: OCMS displays a summary of notices by ID type, notice type, ID number
steps.detail: The 'Court Application Submit Reports' entry has an empty path and its resource is commented out; there is no summary query or endpoint in ocmsadminapi/ocmsadminprivateapi.

steps.step: Court number, court division, court mention date and time are pre-populated
steps.detail: The OcmsCourtCase entity in the API has no court number/division/mention fields; only the UI type has court_no, court_time, mention_date, with no pre-populate logic.

steps.step: CPO can edit those fields before submitting
steps.detail: There is no edit form for court application fields; Court Room No in System.ts is just a generic parameter menu entry.
